scope: Australian Lexus, Nissan and Genesis BEV configurations; read-only evidence bundle. No catalogue/application changes.
interpretation_rules: No formal MY from publication, build or compliance year.
Listing/order acceptance/NEW-unit advertising/delivery separate.
Primary AU current technical table takes precedence over preliminary overseas values or auto-filled dealer data.
Unknown is null; no absent equipment inferred from silence.
Turning radius is not turning diameter; cell voltage is not pack voltage; motor maxima are not summed system output.
Source snapshots are explicitly raw HTML or public web extractions; their hashes authenticate the captured artifact only.
Prices AUD before on-road costs unless exact unit says otherwise. No market-leading or whole-record ranking claims.
Null is unknown; no overseas specification defaults.
Formal MY is independently evidenced, not inferred from build year, compliance year, VIN model-year coding or model-page copyright.
Actual new-stock ads must identify exact grade and NEW category; used/demo/SOLD are excluded.
Manufacturer listing/configure/reserve CTA is separate from order acceptance; dated historical orders-open statement is retained without asserting current factory-order acceptance.
A live advertisement is not a promise of physical unsold stock or delivery time.
Price basis and date are explicit: monthly drive-away campaign, stock-specific drive-away, and historical MSRP remain separate.
Formal MY is independent of build/calendar year. Current active commerce selector plus model code can supersede stale spec-page modelYear; conflicts are explicitly retained.
Exact new-stock proof requires live specific NEW dealer unit, never demo/used/SOLD or generic new-to-order pages. No exact unit passed.
Orders not promoted from listing, price calculator, test-drive, build or refundable-deposit CTAs.
All technical figures use current Australian exact-trim documents. Gross/usable pack, peak DC and cargo gaps remain null.
Safety systems are assistance only; no autonomy capability asserted.
Prices keep tax/on-road basis and illustrative location explicit.
Manufacturer data has stale/copy-paste defects; evidence conflicts are not silently repaired using foreign models.
